title: Chapter 1467 - 11: Legendary Lords From Different Space-Times
content:
Chapter 1467 - 11: Legendary Lords From Different Space-Times

Chapter 1467 - 11: Legendary Lords from Different Space-Times

"Is the will of the Supreme Rule Dao... not wishing for me to continue climbing the white jade stairs?"

Lin Yuan gazed deeply, looking towards the infinite dimensions.

Normally, the calamities involved in the 'Infinite Tribulations' are different for each lord.

But now, for all the Legendary Lords above the billion tribulations, the will of the Supreme Rule Dao has imposed the same calamity-

to stop Lin Yuan from continuing to ascend the white jade stairs. The intention is too obvious.

And according to the meaning of the Purple Light Legendary Lord, any Legendary Lord above a billion tribulations, as long as they successfully stop Lin Yuan from climbing the white jade stairs.

It would be equivalent to directly overcoming a thousand tribulations up to tens of millions of tribulations.

A Legendary Lord near three billion tribulations, successfully stopping Lin Yuan, would be akin to overcoming subsequent thousand tribulations.

While a Legendary Lord just above a billion tribulations, successfully stopping Lin Yuan, would be equivalent to overcoming subsequent tens of millions of tribulations.

One must understand, in the 'Infinite Tribulations', the calamities are linked to strength, and the more tribulations one overcomes, the more they are rewarded by the infinite dimensions with a boost in strength.

The key is, even if they fail to stop Lin Yuan and fail the tribulation, they won't be erased by the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

To be honest, if the target of this calamity weren't himself, Lin Yuan might have been a bit tempted.

"Galaxy, you must be careful."

The Purple Light Legendary Lord transmitted its thoughts.

It had little interest in the calamity imposed by the Supreme Rule Dao.

Firstly, the calamity to stop the Galaxy from ascending the white jade stairs has a threshold for Legendary Lords above a billion tribulations. The Purple Light Legendary Lord hasn't reached this threshold yet, and it got this information from other Legendary Lords of a billion tribulations.

Secondly, on the path of transcending 'Infinite Tribulations', any required tribulation is extremely 'fair!

Simply put, there's no such thing as easily overcoming a tribulation for a Legendary Lord undergoing tribulation.

Want to gain benefits from the infinite dimensions? To advance further in strength, it's not that easy.

And this time, the will of the Supreme Rule Dao imposes the same tribulation on all Legendary Lords above the billion tribulations for a thousand or even ten thousand fold reward.

Even failure incurs no punishment.

How could it possibly be as simple as it seems on the surface?

This kind of 'favor' from the Supreme Rule Dao indicates that the difficulty of the tribulation is beyond all Legendary Lords' imagination. Not to mention, the Purple Light Legendary Lord hasn't reached this threshold yet; even if it did, it probably wouldn't consider it, let alone its acquaintance with Lin Yuan.

"Don't worry."

Lin Yuan wasn't much concerned.

Prevent him from continuing up the white jade stairs?

How to prevent it?

His current altitude on the white jade stairs far surpasses all the Legendary Lords.

Moreover, with the white jade stairs broken in the middle, whether those Legendary Lords can even stay on the stairs is another matter.

Even if the Supreme Rule Dao engages in some unbelievable means, moving all Legendary Lords to his front.

With Lin Yuan's current strength, Lords like Haotian and Fantian, at three billion tribulations, wouldn't last a moment before him.

All the Legendary Lords of this era with billion tribulations joined together, Lin Yuan was confident he could easily shatter them.

After creating a complete "Innate Five Great", Lin Yuan's strength thoroughly surpassed Lords like Haotian and Fantian.

Now he has further evolved three more Chaotic Origin Dao based on the "Innate Five Great".

"The will of the Supreme Rule Dao..."

Lin Yuan, though not worried, wouldn't underestimate it.

For the Supreme Rule Dao to dare impose the calamity to stop his ascent of the white jade stairs, it must mean there's some hope.

"Stopping the Galaxy Lord from climbing the white jade stairs? What a

joke! Has the Supreme Rule Dao gone mad?"

Lords like Haotian and Fantian, at three billion tribulations, shook

their heads immediately after the initial shock.

Perhaps Legendary Lords at a billion or two billion tribulations might be tempted by the calamity imposed by the will of the Supreme Rule

Dao.

But they are different; as the first Legendary Lords to step on the unified white jade stairs, Lords like Haotian know too well the terror

of the Galaxy Lord.

The stronger the power, the higher the realm, the longer one climbs the post-unified white jade stairs.

The more they feel the terror of the Galaxy Lord's power, likely ranking in the top five or even top three among all Legendary Lords since the inception of infinite dimensions.

Moreover, how are they supposed to stop him now? The Galaxy Lord stands towering, on an unknowably high step of the white jade stairs.

They can't even get close.

As for dealing with the Galaxy Lord's other incarnations or authentic forms? It doesn't carry much significance; beings at this level can easily hide in some time-space that they can never find in a lifetime.

"Don't rush."

The Wise One suddenly spoke: "For the Supreme Rule Dao to dare

impose such a calamity implies the possibility of completion, and if not, what does it matter? There won't be any erasure from the

Supreme Rule Dao."

"Right."

"Just wait and see."

Lords like Wan Xiang and Nine Dragons nodded successively.

They are temporarily adopting a wait-and-see attitude towards the calamity imposed by the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

If there are no other variables or support afterward, they would just give up, as at least Lords like Haotian, Fantian, and the Wise One see no hope in successfully obstructing the Galaxy.

Conversely, they'll attempt the tribulation; after all, even if they fail in the end, they won't face erasure from the will of the Supreme Rule

Dao.
